title: It's the Wolves
description: It's the Wolves — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Shivery the Incorrigible Snowman

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Speak with Shivery the Incorrigible Snowman to travel to the Sanctuary of the Snowmen and kill all the wolves in the Sanctuary.

Quest Reward: Gold and 2 King's Coins

Return to: Shivery the Incorrigible Snowman

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Winter Cleaning

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Speak with Shivery the Incorrigible Snowman to travel to the Sanctuary of the Snowmen and kill all the wolves in the Sanctuary.

Offer:

I can't believe how many different wolves have invaded my Sanctuary. Their noses allow them to track me down as soon as I roll back into the Sanctuary. What does snow smell like anyway? Maybe it's the asparagus I ate.

These wolves will need to be dealt with before I can move back to the Sanctuary. You'll need to find a few different varieties, so make sure that there's fresh snow on the ground, or you might not be able to find them all.

Turn-in:

Throw another wolf on the barbie! That's one step closer to me being able to move back into the Sanctuary.

Objectives:

  • Slay Wolf Pups
  • Slay Snow Monster's Best Friend
  • Kill The Abominable Snow Dog

Client level range: 5–?
